verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a desktop remote-access client like AnyDesk, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a way to opt out. The CLI and REST API material covers installation, sessions and account data, which is unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
